action.permissions.reason: command and file-change reverse approvals are correlated and round-trip once

action.tools.reason: only pinned command, file-change, and MCP item families are normalized

action.tools.execute.reason: only pinned command, file-change, and MCP item families are normalized

run.cancel.reason: turn/interrupt targets an exact native thread and turn; settlement is asynchronous

run.instructions.reason: this pin exposes no per-turn instruction override

run.model_selection.reason: turn/start carries the model for one turn

run.reconciliation.reason: state is the adapter's canonical projection of native observations

run.replay.reason: only adapter-emitted events in bounded process memory are replayable

run.resume.reason: thread/resume restores native attachment; canonical replay is bounded process memory

run.structured_output.reason: turn/start.outputSchema constrains the turn's final assistant message

run.tool_selection.reason: this pin exposes no per-turn tool policy

session.compaction.policy.reason: thread/start's config sets model_auto_compact_token_limit for tokens; Codex has no off, and its share applies only at a turn's end, so both are refused

session.open.reopen.reason: thread/resume reloads the thread the session's binding names and reports the model it resumed under

session.reasoning.reason: thread/start's config sets model_reasoning_effort, and a live change rides the next turn/start's effort, which Codex keeps for the turns after it; off is Codex's none

user_input.reason: Codex option questions normalize to OAP single-choice input
